model.name: Objects self-heal (validate on init/read, never run silently drifted)
model.crossRefNote: MVC family (C4 shape, design c4-mvc-view-pipeline-shape.md): R37.4 is the self-heal MODEL (C4.1, its own testable intent — stays narrow); the CONTROLLER (R37.11) and VIEW BUS (R37.12) are DISTINCT-INTENT siblings, NOT folded here (PO split ruling 2026-08-11 — avoids requirement-level over-crediting). evidenceForStep re-parented to R37.11 (controller precondition). T37.4 = coordination root task.
model.description: The pin and board objects VALIDATE on init/read: they reflect reality (recompute from files) or REFUSE to run drifted — they never return a silently-drifted value. Consistency is a property of the objects, not of anyone's vigilance.
model.tronQuote: > Tron AUTHORIZED Sprint 37 = consistency-by-construction (2026-08-07, via robbin-po); files = the ONE source of truth, pin+board = GENERATED views that cannot drift, a FAIL-LOUD guard asserts pin==board==files.

discoverySource.note: Consistency owned by DESIGN not vigilance (CMM4 not CMM2). Build order R37.2->R37.1->R37.3->R37.4.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The pin/board objects VALIDATE on init/read -> either recompute to reflect reality, or REFUSE to run when drifted.
The objects NEVER return a silently-drifted value — always fail-loud or self-correct on read.

TEST EXERCISES AC-validate-on-init+AC-never-silent: construct a drifted pin/board object -> it recomputes to reality OR throws/refuses (never returns silently-wrong). Verify Impl.tests[] on disk before flip.
